question: Will BTC spot price be above $63,500 at 8:00 PM ET on August 16, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase at the observation time (8:00 PM ET on August 16, 2026, i.e. 00:00 UTC on August 17, 2026) is strictly above $63,500.00.
- "No": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase at the observation time is at or below $63,500.00.
